items.question: What causes swollen gums?
items.answer: Swollen gums are commonly caused by plaque buildup, gingivitis, gum infections, poor oral hygiene, hormonal changes, vitamin deficiencies, or periodontal disease.

items.question: Can swollen gums heal without treatment?
items.answer: Mild gum irritation may improve with better oral hygiene, but persistent swelling should be evaluated by a dentist to prevent complications.

items.question: Is swollen gums treatment painful?
items.answer: Most gum treatments are comfortable and performed using gentle techniques. Your dentist will ensure a comfortable experience throughout the procedure.

items.question: How can I prevent swollen gums?
items.answer: Brush twice daily, floss regularly, schedule routine dental cleanings, eat a balanced diet, and avoid tobacco products to maintain healthy gums.

items.question: How much does swollen gums treatment cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the severity of the condition and the treatment required. A consultation allows your dentist to provide an accurate estimate.

items.question: When should I visit a dentist for swollen gums?
items.answer: If your gums remain swollen, bleed frequently, are painful, or you notice persistent bad breath or loose teeth, schedule a dental examination as soon as possible.
